SD64-X01.name: Mugendragon-the-First-Star
SD64-X01.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: Flame Contract/Incarnate & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Unless the opponent sends a core from their Life to the Trash, they can't use Magic cards/[Accel]. If there is any "Mugen" among this Spirit's pre-advents, this effect sends +1 core to the Trash.

[During OC & During Advent] [LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Incarnate" family Spirit makes the first attack of the turn, during this turn, that Spirit can gain two extra Red symbols.

SD64-002.name: Ryuuman-Medieval
SD64-002.effect:
This card/Spirit's symbols and reduction symbols are also treated as Yellow/Blue.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can summon up to three "Incarnate" family Spirit cards/Ultimate cards from your Hand, paying one cost each. For each "Mugen"/"Choco"/"Ian" summoned by this effect, draw a card.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit.

SD64-001.name: Ryuuman-Polaris
SD64-001.effect:
This card/Spirit's symbols and reduction symbols are also treated as Yellow/Blue.

[Burst: After an opposing Spirit's (When Summoned/Reborn) effect resolves]
Draw two cards. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit. Then, if you control any Contract Spirit, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, you can destroy an opposing one-symbol Spirit/Nexus. The effects of the Spirits/Nexuses destroyed by these effects can't activate.

SD64-003.name: Trinity Star
SD64-003.effect:
[Flash]
Immediately end the battle. Then, destroy an opposing 7000 BP or less Spirit. Also, if you control any "Incarnate" family Spirit, during this turn, every opposing Cost 4 or more Spirit/Ultimate can't attack. After this effect resolves, banish this card.

SD64-CX01.name: Mugen (Card)
SD64-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Soul State][Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2]
(Once per turn: Same Name) When your counter increases via your "Incarnate" family effects, you can send the [Soul Core] from the Trash to any of your Spirits/Ultimates.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Your counters +2. Then, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and the effects of the destroyed target can't activate.
